pressCycle.quote: Without resorting to ostentatious virtuosity, articulated phrases, accents, and lyrical lines with remarkable freedom.
…an incredible combination of sensitivity and taste.
The bravura and maturity of his playing render speechless.

bio: Austrian pianist and composer Kiron Atom Tellian has established himself as one of the most compelling young artists of his generation. Praised for his artistry, imagination, and commanding presence at the keyboard, he has appeared on major stages across Europe, the United States, and South America.

The upcoming season spans three continents, with highlights including his solo recital debut at the Wiener Musikverein and appearances with the Orchestre National de Lyon, the Antwerp Symphony Orchestra, and the Dallas Symphony Orchestra. Tellian has completed his Bachelor’s degree at The Juilliard School under Emanuel Ax.
